description: This file contains functions related to upgrading and configuring boot parameters for Asrock devices, including manipulation of MTD partitions and setting upgrade flags.

methods.name: asrock_bootconfig_mangle
methods.description: Manipulates the boot configuration in MTD partitions based on the upgrade operation type (bootcheck or sysupgrade).

methods.name: asrock_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade by setting boot flags and removing certain UBI volumes.
